title: 第11章 没有人天生就是废物第12章 忍无可忍当无需再忍
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
肖岩愣住，猛地回过头来。
只见一位俊朗的白袍青年正含笑的望着他，眼神平静，但却蕴含着一丝鼓励与温和。
“你是谁？也是来看我笑话的吗？”
肖岩咬牙切齿道。
他最恨的就是别人看自己的笑话！
“你误会了！”苏白摇了摇头，随即继续说道：“我并非是来看你笑话的！”
“呵呵.......”
肖岩呵呵一笑，显然不相信苏白的话。
“走走？”苏白笑道：“我们边走边聊？”
“我凭什么跟你走？”肖岩皱眉拒绝道。
“如果你想三年后打败今日侮辱你的人，那就跟我走。”
苏白说完，径直转过身朝着前方走去，不再理会身后的肖岩。
街道两旁，行人络绎不绝，叫卖声不断。
有推着摊子的贩夫走卒，有骑马奔腾的商贾富户，也有身穿锦缎华贵长衫，手持折扇的少爷公子。
更有衣着华贵，谈笑风生的修士，所过之处，众人无不敬仰。
“你刚刚的话是什么意思？”
肖岩追了上来，一脸狐疑的看着苏白。
苏白没有回答，也没有停下脚步，而是继续往前走。
肖岩见状，也不禁加快了步伐，紧跟在苏白身侧。
他倒想看看，这看起来比他大不了多少的少年，葫芦里卖的是什么药！

片刻之后，苏白终于停下了脚步，从兜里掏出十文钱，放在一位躺在地上失去了双腿的乞丐面前。
“谢谢！谢谢！”
乞丐颤颤巍巍的对苏白千恩万谢。
肖岩不明所以，也在口袋里翻了翻，找到了一两银子，也递给了那乞丐。
只是，乞丐看着这发亮的银子，却是不断的挥手摇头，一脸惶恐。
“如果你想害死他，就把这银子给他。”苏白开口了。
“啊？”
肖岩一愣，不解道：“为什么？”
苏白淡淡的扫了他一眼，道：“十文钱可以让他多活三天，一百文钱可以让他多躺三天，一两银子他活不过今晚。”
听到这番话，肖岩的心顿时一沉。
他朝四周看去，才发现有许多手脚健全的乞丐正盯着他手中的银子。
猛然间，他恍然大悟。
“乞丐为了活下去而卑微的跪地乞讨，贩夫走卒为了养活家人而起早贪黑，他们都没有放弃，没有觉得自己是废物。”
“每个人都在为自己的生活而努力，都有其追求的目标。”
“你说，你手脚健全，家境殷实，又为什么觉得自己是废物？”
苏白认真的看着他，一字一句说道。
“因为我无法修炼，无法让柳嫣然高看一眼，无法改变现状！”
肖岩低声说道，他的语气黯然，带着难以言喻的落寞与孤寂。
“这个世界，没有人天生就是废物。”苏白轻声说道：“有的，只是没有找到自己的路罢了。”
“路？我的路在哪？”肖岩自嘲一声。

“我每次修炼，辛辛苦苦炼出一点点灵气，又会马上消散。”
“父亲请了一位筑基高人给我看过，说我没有丹田，不可能炼气成功。”
他无法炼气，此生无缘仙路，这已是定局！
“既然这样，那你刚刚又为何要说出三年之后挑战的话语？”苏白反问。
content_en:
Xiao Yan was stunned and turned around suddenly.
I saw a handsome young man in white robe looking at him with a smile, his eyes were calm, but there was a hint of encouragement and gentleness.
"Who are you? Are you here to see my jokes too?"
Xiao Yan gritted his teeth and said.
What he hates most is others making fun of him!
"You misunderstood!" Su Bai shook his head and then continued: "I didn't come to see your joke!"
"Hehe..."
Xiao Yan laughed, obviously not believing what Su Bai said.
"Let's take a walk?" Su Bai smiled and said, "Let's talk while walking?"
"Why should I go with you?" Xiao Yan frowned and refused.
"If you want to defeat the person who insulted you today in three years, then come with me."
After Su Bai finished speaking, he turned around and walked forward, ignoring Xiao Yan behind him.
On both sides of the street, there was an endless stream of pedestrians and the sound of hawking.
There are vendors and footmen pushing stalls, merchants and wealthy merchants galloping on horseback, and young masters wearing luxurious brocade gowns and holding folding fans.
There are also monks who are dressed luxuriously and talk and laugh happily. Everyone admires them wherever they go.
"What do you mean by what you just said?"
Xiao Yan chased after him and looked at Su Bai suspiciously.
Su Bai did not answer or stop, but continued to walk forward.
When Xiao Yan saw this, he couldn't help but quicken his pace and followed Su Bai closely.
He wanted to see what kind of medicine this young man who looked not much older than him was selling in the gourd!
After a while, Su Bai finally stopped, took out ten cents from his pocket, and placed it in front of a beggar who was lying on the ground and had lost his legs.
"Thank you! Thank you!"
The beggar tremblingly thanked Su Bai profusely.
Xiao Yan didn't know why, so he rummaged through his pockets, found a tael of silver, and handed it to the beggar.
However, the beggar looked at the shiny silver and kept waving his hands and shaking his head with a look of fear on his face.
"If you want to kill him, give him this money." Su Bai said.
"Huh?"
Xiao Yan was stunned and asked in confusion: "Why?"
Su Bai glanced at him lightly and said, "Ten cents can keep him alive for three more days, one hundred cents can keep him lying in bed for three more days, and one tael of silver can keep him alive tonight."
Hearing these words, Xiao Yan's heart suddenly sank.
He looked around and found many beggars with sound hands and feet staring at the silver in his hand.
Suddenly, it dawned on him.
"Beggars humbly beg on their knees in order to survive, and traffickers and slaves work from dawn to dusk in order to feed their families. They have never given up, and they have never felt that they are useless."
"Everyone is working hard for their own life and has goals they pursue."
"Tell me, you have sound hands and feet and a well-off family, so why do you think you are a waste?"
Su Bai looked at him seriously and said every word.
"Because I can't practice, I can't let Liu Yanran take a look, I can't change the status quo!"
Xiao Yan whispered, his tone was gloomy, with an indescribable loneliness and loneliness.
"No one in this world is born a waste." Su Bai said softly: "Some people are, they just haven't found their own way."
"Road? Where is my road?" Xiao Yan laughed at himself.
"Every time I practice, I work hard to cultivate a little bit of spiritual energy, but it will dissipate immediately."
"My father asked a foundation-building expert to show it to me and said that since I don't have a dantian, it's impossible for me to successfully refine my qi."
He cannot refine his Qi and will never be able to achieve immortality in this life. This is a foregone conclusion!
"In that case, why did you just say the words of challenge three years later?" Su Bai asked back.
